headline.text: Four foreign-material events across L1 and L3 — machine part missing at S4, belt fibers at S3, plastic connector at S3, *spatula in chocolate* at ML1 — plus one allergen cross-contact.

summary: Active hold: 4.5 pallets of unlabeled jars at L1 S2 pending disposition. Four foreign-material findings today required product inspection and area cleaning; all equipment accounted for by window close. One allergen wash area cross-contact at L1 S3.

holds.title: 4.5 pallets unlabeled jars — S2 labeler failures
holds.summary: Label printer ribbon and sensor failures accumulated 4.5 pallets of filled jars without labels; printer operational by 08:38, jars on hold pending rework or disposition.
holds.status: On hold pending QA disposition — printer resolved, unlabeled jars staged for rework.

food_safety.title: Machine part broke, fragment missing — S4 Theegarten
food_safety.summary: Theegarten part came loose and broke; missing fragment searched in scrap bin and three boxes of finished product, likely discarded with scrap per shift lead.
food_safety.status: Resolved — fragment not found in finished product, most likely discarded with scrap during Theegarten cleaning.

food_safety.title: C24 belt frayed, fibers in Matrix 3 — S3
food_safety.summary: Belt shifted and frayed significantly; fibers found in Matrix 3 area, maintenance replaced belt, QA ATP passed; checking pallet bags for foreign material.
food_safety.status: Resolved — belt replaced and ATP passed at 11:06, area cleaned, pallet bags inspected for contamination.

food_safety.title: Spatula found in hardened chocolate — ML1 Sweco
food_safety.summary: Operators found spatula inside hardened chocolate during Sweco inspection; no product in process, tool accounted for before startup.
food_safety.status: Resolved — spatula removed, no product exposure, Sweco cleaned and ATP passed before depositing resumed.

food_safety.title: Plastic belt connector found at MM4 — S3
food_safety.summary: Blue-belt plastic connector found by first blue belt at MM4; verified as belt fastener, all current belts inspected and intact.
food_safety.status: Resolved — connector identified as plastic belt fastener, all active belts verified intact.

quality.title: Unsealed pistachio bag from supplier — S3
quality.summary: One bag in box not sealed by manufacturer; QA taste-tested for staleness, approved for use blended with sealed bags to dilute any quality variation.
quality.status: Resolved — QA approved for use mixed with sealed product after sensory evaluation.

sanitation.title: Caustic wash incomplete due to supply outage — S4
sanitation.summary: Ran out of caustic mid-clean; only one caustic cycle completed instead of two, equipment ran after supervisor visual approval, second cycle completed once caustic sourced.
sanitation.status: Resolved — second caustic cycle completed at 08:32 after caustic located in building, full cleaning protocol met.

sanitation.title: Fibers found in S4 tunnel 2 — cleaning-roller source
sanitation.summary: Lot of fibers discovered in tunnel 2; traced to clogged cooling-tunnel filters, maintenance cleaned with compressed air, replacement filters arrive tomorrow.
sanitation.status: Resolved — tunnel cleaned, filters cleared with compressed air, QA inspected and cleared for startup.

sanitation.title: Cavanna vacuum areas clogged — Truffle line CILT
sanitation.summary: Vacuum pickup areas on Cavannas not cleaned during CILT, causing machine jams and 10-bin accumulation; cleaned after line down, operators reminded of CILT scope.
sanitation.status: Resolved — vacuum areas cleaned, Cavannas operational, CILT checklist reinforced with team.

sanitation.title: Food-contact labels left exposed — S4
sanitation.summary: Label roll for food-contact labels left out of protective bag on second shift; corrected immediately, exposed labels removed and discarded.
sanitation.status: Resolved — exposed labels discarded, remaining roll returned to sealed bag.

allergen.title: Non-allergen wash area contaminated with pistachios — S3
allergen.summary: Wash area 1 (designated non-allergen) used by S3 swing shift for pistachio equipment; area contaminated and flagged for re-cleaning before non-allergen use.
allergen.status: Open — area flagged for allergen cleaning, shift leads notified to review wash area assignments with operators.

opportunities.text: Consider adding pre-startup inspection of Theegarten mechanical parts to S4 checklist — based on today's loose part that broke and required scrap-bin and finished-product searches.
Review belt preventive-maintenance intervals for Matrix conveyor belts — based on S3 C24 belt fraying that released fibers into production area.
Add wash-area allergen-zone training to onboarding and refresher — based on S3 team using non-allergen wash area 1 for pistachio equipment.
Review tool accountability at depositor and Sweco areas — based on today's spatula found in hardened chocolate at ML1.
Add Cavanna vacuum-area cleaning to Truffle CILT checklist as photo-verification step — based on today's clogged vacuum causing line jams.
